records.headline: Lindsay Clancy's mother testifies in court: 'She was a loving mother'
records.summary: Lindsay Clancy's mother, Paula Musgrove, testified Monday in her daughter's murder trial. Musgrove described 36-year-old Clancy as a "loving mother" and spoke about the decline of her mental health in the months before she fatally strangled her three young children in January 2023. Clancy’s defense has admitted to the killings but said she was suffering from postpartum psychosis and was not “criminally responsible.”

records.headline: US airman arrested at Capitol: Pres. Trump 'has failed us'
records.summary: In a CNN exclusive, the airman who was arrested last month on the steps of the US Capitol for calling for President Trump's impeachment is speaking out in his first television interview. Air Force Major Jason Watson tells Erin Burnett that the president is "flagrantly violating the Constitution" and he hopes his actions "inspire Americans to act."

records.headline: From the CNN archives: Hayden Panettiere opens up about paparazzi pressures
records.summary: 18-year-old Hayden Panettiere sat down with CNN in 2007 to discuss her insecurities, and how the behavior of paparazzi changed once she turned 18. Panettiere was pronounced dead on Sunday afternoon after being found unresponsive at an apartment complex in South Carolina. She was 36.

records.headline: Hayden Panettiere’s personal ties to Ukraine
records.summary: Actress Hayden Panettiere has died at age 36, according to police. Her relationship with Ukrainian boxing champion Wladimir Klitschko, with whom she shared a daughter, connected her closely to Ukraine, where she advocated on social media and founded Hoplon International to fund medical kits and protective gear following Russia’s full-scale invasion.

records.headline: Train floods after heavy rain sweeps across Manila
records.summary: Floodwaters overwhelmed parts of the Philippines’ northern island of Luzon after being hit by monsoon-fueled storms.

records.headline: Thousands gather for vigil honoring former Cambridge professor Jason Arday
records.summary: A UK anti-bigotry group, Stand Up to Racism, held a vigil in London’s Trafalgar Square in Jason Arday’s memory, describing the media coverage of his scandal as “a racist witch hunt” organized by the far-right. CNN’s Anna Cooban reports.

records.headline: Braving one of Europe's tallest waterslides
records.summary: At Antalya’s Land of Legends theme park on the Turkish Riviera, CNN producer Leroy Ah Ben tests his nerves on the Dragonfly Tower, a 52-meter-high attraction featuring one of Europe’s tallest waterslides.

records.headline: Why Trump is pressuring South Korea
records.summary: President Donald Trump announced on Sunday he would scale back major military drills with South Korea, just as annual joint military exercises were about to begin. CNN’s Stephen Collinson explains why this move could deepen concerns that Washington is dumping its alliances while also being a concession to North Korea’s Kim Jong Un.

records.headline: Tupac Shakur had a message for his critics during a 1995 interview with CNN
records.summary: In a 1995 interview with CNN, hip-hop legend Tupac Shakur called on his critics "to be fair" in their criticism of his music.

records.headline: Trump meets with 16-year-old lifeguard who saved boy in California
records.summary: President Donald Trump met with the 16-year-old lifeguard, Ryder Williams, who saved a boy's life at a beach in California.

records.headline: CNN first to see Ukraine’s empty Patriot launchers
records.summary: Russian ballistic attacks on Ukraine have surged as its stock of Patriot interceptor missiles almost runs dry. Nick Paton Walsh explains why the US-made system is so critical as he gets the first media access to Patriot launchers sitting in a quiet field with empty canisters.

records.headline: Who is Trump's close aide, Natalie Harp?
records.summary: Georgia Sen. Jon Ossoff, who is up for reelection in November, took a swing at Natalie Harp, President Donald Trump's executive assistant. CNN's Betsy Klein explains who Harp is and how her relationship with the president has evolved over the years.

records.headline: Drought crisis in Western US notches grim milestone
records.summary: The second-largest reservoir in the country is at a record low, threatening water and power supply for millions and marring an iconic landmark of the American West.

records.headline: Palestinian-American returns to home under settler siege
records.summary: Loui Ridi reached his West Bank home on Monday, more than a week after it came under siege by Israeli settlers — only to find settlers still roaming freely. A Palestinian-American living in Ohio, he traveled to his native village of Qusra in the occupied West Bank to support his brother and nephew, who have been trapped inside the house. The Israeli military declared the area a closed military zone, and Ridi was only able to reach his home under Israeli military escort. CNN's Jeremy Diamond joined him on the journey.

records.headline: Unseen images of El Chapo released by Mexican media
records.summary: Mexican media outlets, Aristegui Noticias and El Universal, have released what they describe as previously unseen images showing Joaquín “El Chapo” Guzmán moments after his arrest.

records.headline: Forget cheesesteaks. Philly has pigeon tours now
records.summary: After rescuing a sick pigeon, a Philadelphia couple turned their newfound passion for the bird into a weekly pigeon tour.

records.headline: Remains found near Guthrie’s home with no connection to case 'at this time'
records.summary: The Pima County Sheriff’s Department says human remains have been found in a desert around 15 miles from Nancy Guthrie’s home in southwest Tucson, Arizona but are not connected to the case “at this time.”

records.headline: A heat dome is gripping the South. Here’s what causes one and what it looks like
records.summary: A heat dome is cooking the South. Meteorologist Chris Warren and multimedia designer Ashley Burke animate and explain what causes this thermal atmospheric anomaly.

records.headline: Snowplow clears massive hail buildup after Colorado storm
records.summary: A severe storm in Colorado dropped heavy rain and hail that combined into towering mounds. Snowplow crews were called in to clear the hail-covered roads in Douglas County.

records.headline: Tips to keep mosquitoes away
records.summary: CNN’s Meg Tirrell talks with a scientist who studies mosquitoes and has tips on how to outsmart them in our homes and yards.

records.headline: Judge who sentenced al-Assad to death was condemned by his regime
records.summary: Ironically, the Syrian judge who sentenced President Bashar al-Assad to death in absentia last week was himself sentenced to death by the same regime years earlier. Judge Fakhr al-Din al-Aryan defected from the Ministry of Justice in 2013 joining the judicial bodies of the opposition. CNN's Paula Hancocks has more.

records.headline: British PM texted scammer who posed as Trump chief of staff
records.summary: Andy Burnham, Britain's prime minister, exchanged messages with someone pretending to be White House Chief of Staff Susie Wiles, a source told CNN. A White House official says the incident had "nothing to do" with Wiles' phone being hacked.

records.headline: New details in the death of Hayden Panettiere
records.summary: CNN's Omar Jimenez reports on new details in the death of Hayden Panettiere, including that emergency officials were responding to a 911 call about a reported cardiac arrest when they found her unresponsive at a Greenville, South Carolina, apartment complex.

records.headline: Hawaii floods sweep away paramedics' truck
records.summary: The National Guard rescued two paramedics in Hawaii after their truck was swept away by flooding from Hurricane Lala.

records.headline: Trial begins in alleged murder-for-hire plot
records.summary: Mario Fernandez Saldana's trial has begun in Florida, where prosecutors say he was part of an elaborate murder-for-hire plot in the 2022 killing of Jared Bridegan. CNN's Isabel Rosales reports.

records.headline: Witness recounts ambulance ride to hospital with Tupac Shakur after he was shot
records.summary: Garry Dale, a former Las Vegas Metropolitan Police Department officer, answered questions from prosecution on Monday about riding in the ambulance to the hospital with Tupac Shakur after he had been shot on September 7, 1996.

records.headline: Video shows fuel tank explosion in Oklahoma
records.summary: A lightning strike caused a fire at the Explorer Pipeline tank farm in Glenpool, Oklahoma, leading to an explosion that sent the lid of a tank up into the sky. The fire is now under control and no injuries have been reported, city officials say.

records.headline: Tupac Shakur talks about his image in '93 intv for his film 'Poetic Justice'
records.summary: In a 1993 interview with CNN, hip-hop legend Tupac Shakur talked about his film, “Poetic Justice” and about people seeing him “in a positive light for a change.”
